part2.transcript: Who are you going to send on the business trip? (A) I've picked Susan in accounting. (B) It was a very rewarding trip. (C) At the start of next year.
Why don't we go for a bike ride tomorrow? (A) I gave Mr. Holland a ride to the airport. (B) That sounds like fun. (C) It was 3:30 PM.
Did Monica answer the phone, or was she away from the office? (A) I'll mark it on the calendar at the office. (B) Please leave a message. (C) She was meeting her client at that time.
Which theater is the movie showing at? (A) He's a famous actor. (B) Well, I'll have to check. (C) She's over there.
Why is there a moving truck parked outside? (A) We're removing coffee stains. (B) Into a bigger office. (C) Because new neighbors are moving in.
What should I bring on the camping trip? (A) You'll need hiking boots. (B) He's on a business trip with his colleague. (C) Yes, we should.
You will receive five days off next month. (A) I had a great time at the resort (B) I turned the equipment off. (C) Will it be paid or unpaid?
Did Olivia already return the rental car? (A) Yes, just this morning. (B) There are several different models. (C) I'm ready to order now.
Isn't this area off limits to motor vehicles? (A) It's fifty percent off today. (B) There is a walking path only. (C) Actually, it's a stolen vehicle.
I'd recommend using the stairs today. (A) Can you tell me why? (B) No, I didn't stare straight into the camera. (C) I usually use the copy machine at the corner.
When will I receive this month's paycheck? (A) The conference will be held next month. (B) Before March 3. (C) In the bottom drawer.
Do we have enough gas to get to the airport? (A) Who arrived at the airport yesterday? (B) We don't have to worry about it. (C) She's the chief flight attendant.
Why hasn't the travel itinerary been sent out yet? (A) At Terminal 6. (B) He was a travel agent. (C) We haven't decided on the dates.
Who forgot to turn off the lights last night? (A) We were waiting at the traffic lights. (B) I'm guessing it was John. (C) Kelly will take a day off tomorrow.
We are offering a promotional deal at the moment. (A) Congratulations on your promotion. (B) What benefit can I get? (C) Jenny will deal with the complaint.
I can borrow your book for a few days, can't I? (A) A few co-workers. (B) Of course. It's no trouble at all. (C) They booked tickets in advance.

Didn't your team improve your sales figures compared to last month? (A) Yes, the budget proposal is due this Friday. (B) Actually, they were about the same. (C) I couldn't figure out how to use this product.
How can I find her contact information? (A) We negotiated a contract. (B) By Wednesday at the latest. (C) Check the client list.
Where is the coffee shop you recommended? (A) I usually wear a suit. (B) It's across from the post office. (C) It's 3 o'clock sharp.
Would you like to drive instead of me? (A) It looks like he missed the bus. (B) Yes, I'll call right now. (C) Sorry, I can't. I forgot my glasses.
Did you say you were stopping by today or tomorrow? (A) Actually, I said this weekend. (B) A nice day for a walk. (C) Yeah, I thought so too.
Food will be catered for tonight's party, won't it? (A) It was my birthday party. (B) It's scheduled to arrive at 6 o'clock. (C) No, he isn't registered here.
Isn't Mr. Rolland away from the office this week? (A) Yes, he comes back next Monday. (B) This product will be released next week. (C) Don't throw the receipt away.
I fixed the printer in the break room this morning. (A) You're welcome. (B) Was it out of order? (C) I was in the meeting room.
What did the tennis instructor say? (A) She said to practice more. (B) Have you decided on a date? (C) I told you so.
